{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion beam''' was produced by the [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer|ion paddle beamer]] created by the [[Ssi-ruu]]k. A threadlike silvery energy beam, the ion beam was engineered to paralyze an organic being by interfering with the target's [[nervous system]] and rendering them unconscious. A glancing blow to an extremity can be numbed for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], and an ion beam blast at close range could [[Death/Legends|kill]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
